title: Core Duo #46
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio, two women in a single row.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 2 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Korean woman in her late 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, fair ivory skin, smoky eyes in champagne-gold glitter shadow, a sharp winged liner, full lashes, softly contoured cheekbones with a glowing highlight, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy gradient lips in deep rose, a confident, luminous expression, sultry, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in sleek straight, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, glittery finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a professional female bodybuilder physique carrying around 230 pounds of dense, hard, fully developed muscle, with the most extreme glute and hip development. Gigantic rounded shoulders with visible separation between the front, side and rear deltoids, thick swollen biceps and triceps with a deep split between them, wide flaring lats, a deeply carved abdomen with sharp obliques, colossal glutes and hips so massively muscular they extend far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep outer sweep and a visible teardrop shape above each knee, thick hamstrings, and diamond-shaped calves. The waist is narrow only in contrast to the massive hips and shoulders. Every muscle group is separated by deep grooves and hard edges. Hard and muscular, not soft, not a plus-size body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Ukrainian pysanka egg-art linework — a deep black ground with fine red, gold and white geometric linework, wide gold-and-red bands following every deep crease, dense geometric wax-resist linework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.

Left woman's footwear: extreme gold-and-red sculptural heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Yoruba Nigerian woman in her late 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter on the cheekbones, warm gold and bronze eyeshadow blended up to the brow bone, sharply defined arched brows, a precise winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep wine-red glossy lip, a large sculpted gele head-wrap of stiff gold-and-cream fabric folded high above her head, a poised, joyful, radiant expression, bold and confident, sleek silver-grey hair styled in a classic French braid from the crown, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, holographic finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Italian Deruta majolica — a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre-yellow floral medallions, wide cobalt-and-ochre bands following every deep crease, dense repeating floral border filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.

Right woman's footwear: extreme cobalt-and-ochre platform stiletto pumps, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 2, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 landscape 8K.
